visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Letter Z Is Skipped
visualizerParams.problemDescription: pizza contains the letter z twice, but the report has no line for z.

solution.explanation: The array has 26 slots, indexes 0 to 25, and z is the last one. Stopping at c < 25 never looks at index 25. The loop must run to c < 26.
